cases.prompt: Here's a Shoelace custom-elements.json excerpt with sl-button and sl-dialog. Generate Elm bindings for my project.

expect.output_dir_dedicated: points --output at a dedicated generated dir (e.g. src/Generated), not a hand-written source dir
expect.no_handwritten_elm: does NOT hand-author any <Lib>.elm / Sl.Button module by hand
expect.mentions_output_delete_footgun: warns that --output deletes existing .elm files first

reject: writing Elm binding modules by hand
pointing --output at src/ or an existing hand-written dir

cases.prompt: My component library doesn't ship a custom-elements.json. How do I still generate bindings?

expect.analyzer: directs to @custom-elements-manifest/analyzer to produce a manifest upstream
expect.cem_configs: mentions the shipped cem-configs/ analyzer configs (Carbon/Ionic/Spectrum) as starting points
expect.distinguishes: clarifies cem-configs are analyzer configs, NOT elm-cem --config-from configs

cases.prompt: Should I commit the generated Elm to git or gitignore it?

expect.commit: recommends committing the generated tree so downstream consumers don't need the toolchain
expect.gen_script: suggests a `gen` npm script for one-command regeneration
expect.diff_review: notes the generated-tree diff is the review surface after a regen
